task: Build the list of Fibonacci numbers up to 13, that is 1 1 2 3 5 8 13, by writing and evaluating lisp code; store the list as answer. When achieved, evaluate (final true).
lesson: Today I learned the append function requires the accumulator list as the first argument, not the result list.

nodes.code: (begin (set! a 1) (set! b 1) (set! out (list 1 1)) (while (<= a 13) (set! out (append out (list b))) (set! tmp b) (set! b (+ a b)) (set! a tmp)) (rlm-set answer out) (final true))
